entities.summary: Kina Konova, born Kina Mutafova, was a Bulgarian educator, translator, publicist, suffragist and women's rights activist. She was a co-founder and leader of the first local women's socialist organization in Bulgaria, the Society of Friends. Women's Branch (1889), and she was a founder of the local women's society Nadezhda (hope) in 1897.
